recognize_zh: 移植前骨髓切片 (A) 骨小樑明顯增厚融合、骨髓腔被細胞浸潤，免疫染色 (B) 呈大片瀰漫陽性；移植後 (C) 骨小樑恢復纖細、脂肪空泡回復，免疫染色 (D) 只剩零星陽性，顯示全身性肥大細胞增生症的骨硬化在異體移植後消退。
features: Panel A (pre-HCT, H&E): markedly thickened, irregular, anastomosing bone trabeculae (osteosclerosis) with hypercellular marrow spaces
Panel B (pre-HCT, IHC, marker unlabeled): diffuse strong staining filling intertrabecular spaces, indicating extensive mast cell infiltration
Panel C (post-HCT, H&E): thin, regular trabeculae with normocellular marrow containing fat
Panel D (post-HCT, IHC, marker unlabeled): only scattered weak staining without dense aggregates
Low-power images only; individual mast cell spindle morphology cannot be assessed
describe_en: The pretransplant bone marrow biopsy shows marked osteosclerosis with thickened, anastomosing trabeculae and intertrabecular spaces that are diffusely infiltrated and strongly positive on immunohistochemistry (marker not labeled, presumably a mast cell marker such as tryptase or CD117). The post-allogeneic transplant biopsy shows restoration of thin trabeculae, normocellular marrow with fat, and only scattered positive cells without compact aggregates. Findings are consistent with systemic mastocytosis with osteosclerosis and its histologic regression after allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation.

ddx.vs: PMF shows atypical megakaryocyte clusters with reticulin/collagen fibrosis and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations, without tryptase/CD25+ spindle mast cell aggregates or KIT D816V.
Metastatic carcinoma forms cytokeratin-positive epithelial nests in a desmoplastic stroma.
Metabolic bone disease shows osteoclastic resorption and peritrabecular fibrosis without a diffuse mast cell infiltrate.
